name: Monitor/wall lizard
mustPaint: legs splayed sideways with elbows out; belly near the ground
tail about 1.5x the body (the tail morph then covers skinks through whiptails)
fine scale texture on a plain unmarked mid-tone base (luminance is kept, so any painted mark shows on every species this stands in for)
masks: striped = whiptail/skink stripes, banded = tegu/gila bands, spotted, mottled
why: 17 misleading. A scaly sprawling reptile replaces a furry mammal. The heavy lizards (Monitor, Komodo, Tegu, Gila) and the crested iguanas stay caveat. A second, heavy Monitor Lizard painting would lift them later.
